disqualifier.note: Independent disablement causes from three upstreams (disposition Option, review AsyncResult, detail waiting) plus a derived OR. actionsDisabled is a priority conjunction over free combinations, not a masked union; resolved+busy+waiting can all be true together after a just-recorded review.

Independent UI axes: disabled is the shared actionsDisabled OR (resolved/reviewBusy/waiting) and selected is whether this proposal is the review-dialog target. Write site assigns them from different sources; all four combinations occur (a selected proposal stays disabled while a review is in flight).

evidence.note: Valid blocks append to the buffer only after the holding latch is true, so a non-empty buffer while streaming is unreachable.
The first invalid slice activates holding and appends the mandatory failure report before any later valid slice can be buffered.

notes: One streaming | holding(failures, buffered) Ref replaces three correlated Refs.
